critic.fix_suggestion: Duplicate the existing window row geometry along the fuselage to create two distinct rows (upper and lower deck). Set the vertical offset between the original and new row to 15% of the total cabin height, ensuring they are parallel and evenly spaced across the length of the fuselage.
